parsed.scene_description: The image shows the entrance of a building with a large glass door. The door is made of glass and has a handle on the right side. The floor is covered with black tiles and there are two white doors on either side of the door. On the left side, there is a small window with a view of the outside. The walls are painted in a light beige color and there is an air conditioning unit on the wall above the door and a sign above it that reads "Exit". The entrance appears to be empty and is well-lit.
